name: Kill brick
summary: Kills any player or NPC that touches the part, and makes it glow red.
where: In Roblox Studio, insert a Script inside the Part you want to be deadly. Nothing else to set up.

name: Kill bricks folder (one script for all)
summary: One script that makes every part inside a KillBricks folder deadly, including parts added later.
where: Put a Script in ServerScriptService. First create a Folder in Workspace named KillBricks and put your deadly parts in it.

name: Moving part (back and forth)
summary: Slides a part back and forth forever with TweenService, and carries players standing on it.
where: Insert a Script inside the Part where the platform should start. Change MOVE_BY to set how far and which way it moves.

name: Spinning part
summary: Spins a part around forever on the axis you choose, and carries players standing on it.
where: Insert a Script inside the Part you want to spin. Pick SPIN_AXIS and DEGREES_PER_SECOND at the top.

name: Disappearing platform
summary: Fades out when stepped on, lets the player fall through, then comes back after a few seconds.
where: Insert a Script inside the Part (the platform). Nothing else to set up.

name: Two-way teleporter pads
summary: Step on PadA to teleport to PadB and back, with a cooldown so you don't bounce back and forth.
where: Make a Model or Folder in Workspace with two Parts named PadA and PadB, and insert this Script into that same Model/Folder.

name: Obby checkpoints
summary: Saves your stage when you touch a numbered checkpoint and respawns you there, with a Stage leaderboard.
where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Create a Folder in Workspace named Checkpoints holding anchored Parts named 1, 2, 3 and so on (1 = start), and keep one normal SpawnLocation at the start.

name: Jump pad
summary: Launches players high into the air when they step on it, using a short LinearVelocity push.
where: Insert a Script inside a flat anchored Part on the ground. Change JUMP_SPEED to jump higher.

name: Launch pad (forward cannon)
summary: Shoots players forward and up in the direction the pad's front face points.
where: Insert a Script inside an anchored Part and rotate the part so its Front face points where players should fly.

name: Speed pad
summary: Gives players a burst of speed for a few seconds, then puts their speed back to normal.
where: Insert a Script inside a flat anchored Part on the ground. Change BOOST_SPEED and BOOST_TIME at the top.

name: Opening door (press E, click or touch)
summary: A door that slides open with a ProximityPrompt, ClickDetector or touch, then closes by itself.
where: Insert a Script inside your anchored door Part and set OPEN_MODE to "Prompt", "Click" or "Touch".

name: Collectable coins + leaderstats
summary: Adds a Coins leaderstat and gives coins when players touch coin parts, which respawn after a while.
where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Create a Folder in Workspace named Coins and put your coin Parts inside it.

name: Spinning + bobbing coins
summary: Smoothly spins and floats every coin in the Coins folder on each player's screen.
where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. It animates the parts in the Workspace folder named Coins.

name: Save leaderstats (DataStore)
summary: Saves and loads all leaderstats numbers with pcall, retries, autosave and BindToClose.
where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Publish the game and turn on Game Settings > Security > Enable Studio Access to API Services first.

name: Day/night cycle
summary: Moves the sun and moon over time and switches lamps in a NightLights folder on at night.
where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Optional: a Workspace folder named NightLights with lamp Parts that contain PointLights.

name: Rising lava (resets)
summary: Lava that slowly rises, kills anyone inside it, then drops back down and rises again.
where: Insert a Script inside a big flat Part at the bottom of your map. Set RISE_HEIGHT and RISE_TIME at the top.

name: Conveyor belt
summary: Pushes anything standing on the part along, like an airport walkway.
where: Insert a Script inside a long flat Part. Things move toward the part's Front face; make SPEED negative to reverse.

name: Heal pad
summary: Gives health back to players who step on it, with a cooldown and a green flash.
where: Insert a Script inside a flat anchored Part. Change HEAL_AMOUNT and COOLDOWN at the top.

name: Damage zone (over time)
summary: Hurts anyone standing inside the part a little every second, like poison gas.
where: Insert a Script inside a Part that covers the dangerous area; the script makes it see-through and walk-through.

name: Sword tool
summary: A simple sword: click to swing, damages others with a cooldown and tags them for kill credit.
where: Insert a Tool in StarterPack with a Part named Handle (Anchored and CanCollide off), then insert this Script inside the Tool.

name: Follower NPC (chases nearest player)
summary: Makes an NPC walk toward the nearest player with Humanoid:MoveTo, and can bite like a zombie.
where: Insert a Script inside an unanchored NPC Model (from Avatar > Rig Builder) that has a Humanoid and HumanoidRootPart.

name: Shop (server)
summary: The server side of a shop: checks prices, takes coins and gives tools safely via a RemoteEvent.
where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Create a Folder named ShopItems in ServerStorage with your Tools, and list their names and prices in PRICES. Use with shop-button.

name: Shop button (client)
summary: A shop GUI button that asks the server to buy an item and shows whether it worked.
where: Insert a LocalScript inside a TextButton in a ScreenGui in StarterGui, and name the button the same as the tool it sells. Needs the shop-server script.

name: Round system (intermission + timer)
summary: Runs intermission and round countdowns, teleports players to an arena, and gives survivors a Win.
where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Create two anchored Parts in Workspace named LobbySpawn and ArenaSpawn. It makes a StringValue named Status in ReplicatedStorage.

name: Status label (shows round timer)
summary: Shows the Status text from ReplicatedStorage on the screen, updating live.
where: Insert a LocalScript inside a TextLabel in a ScreenGui in StarterGui. Needs the round-timer script (or any StringValue named Status in ReplicatedStorage).

name: Team-only door
summary: A door only one team can walk through, using collision groups so others can't sneak in.
where: Insert a Script inside your anchored door Part and set TEAM_NAME to the exact name of a Team you made under Teams.

name: Kills + deaths leaderboard
summary: Adds Kills and Deaths to the player list and gives a kill to whoever tagged the victim last.
where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService. Use weapons that add a creator tag (the sword-tool script does).

name: Win pad
summary: Gives +1 Win when touched and sends the player back to the start.
where: Insert a Script inside an anchored Part at the end of your obby. Works with the checkpoints script.

name: Double jump
summary: Lets players jump again while in the air (works with keyboard, phone and controller).
where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.

name: Sprint with Shift
summary: Hold Left Shift (or tap the on-screen button on mobile) to run faster with a camera zoom effect.
where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.

name: Give tool pad
summary: Gives a tool from ServerStorage to players who step on the pad, one copy each.
where: Put your Tool in ServerStorage, then insert this Script inside an anchored Part and set TOOL_NAME to the tool's name.

name: Background music playlist
summary: Plays all songs in a Music folder one after another (shuffled), with M to mute.
where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts. Create a Folder named Music in SoundService with Sound objects that have SoundIds set.

name: Sound on touch
summary: Plays a sound when a player touches the part, with a cooldown.
where: Insert a Script inside the Part, and either put a Sound inside the Part or type its ID into SOUND_ID.

name: Timed bomb
summary: Blinks for a countdown after being touched, then explodes, hurts nearby players and comes back later.
where: Insert a Script inside a Part (a black Ball works great). Nothing else to set up.

name: Rainbow part
summary: Smoothly cycles a part through every color of the rainbow.
where: Insert a Script inside the Part (Neon material looks best).

name: Button bridge
summary: Step on a button to make a hidden bridge appear for a few seconds.
where: Make a Model in Workspace with a Part named Button and a Folder named Bridge (holding the bridge Parts), and insert this Script into that Model.

name: Helpers module
summary: Reusable helper functions (player from hit, leaderstats, touch with cooldown, time format) for your other scripts.
where: Insert a ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage named Helpers and paste this in; other scripts use require on it (examples at the top).

name: Blink an LED
summary: Turns an LED on and off every half second (the Arduino Hello World).
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. Uses the built-in LED on pin 13, or an LED + 220 ohm resistor on pin 13.

name: Button toggles LED (debounced)
summary: Press a button to switch an LED on or off, with debounce so one press counts once.
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. Button between pin 2 and GND (uses INPUT_PULLUP), LED + 220 ohm resistor on pin 13.

name: Servo sweep
summary: Sweeps a servo motor from 0 to 180 degrees and back.
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. Servo signal wire to pin 9, red to 5V, brown/black to GND. Servo.h comes with the IDE.

name: Ultrasonic distance (HC-SR04)
summary: Measures distance with an HC-SR04 and prints centimeters to the Serial Monitor.
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. Trig to pin 9, Echo to pin 10, VCC to 5V, GND to GND; open the Serial Monitor at 9600 baud.

name: DC motor with L298N
summary: Controls a DC motor's speed and direction with an L298N driver.
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. ENA to pin 9 (remove the ENA jumper), IN1 to pin 8, IN2 to pin 7, motor on OUT1/OUT2, separate battery with shared GND.

name: LED strip rainbow (NeoPixel)
summary: Shows a moving rainbow on a WS2812B/NeoPixel LED strip.
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. Install Adafruit NeoPixel from Tools > Manage Libraries first. Strip DIN to pin 6 through a 330 ohm resistor, 5V and GND to power.

name: Joystick reader
summary: Reads a thumb joystick's X/Y and click button and prints the direction.
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. VRx to A0, VRy to A1, SW to pin 2, +5V to 5V, GND to GND; open the Serial Monitor at 9600 baud.

name: Buzzer melody
summary: Plays Twinkle Twinkle Little Star on a passive buzzer with tone(), and again when a button is pressed.
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. Passive buzzer + to pin 8 and - to GND; optional button between pin 2 and GND.

name: Potentiometer LED dimmer
summary: Turn a knob to make an LED brighter or dimmer with analogWrite.
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. Potentiometer middle leg to A0 (outer legs to 5V and GND), LED + 220 ohm resistor on PWM pin 9.

name: Temperature + humidity (DHT11)
summary: Reads temperature and humidity from a DHT11 every 2 seconds and lights an LED when it's hot.
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. Install "DHT sensor library" by Adafruit (plus Adafruit Unified Sensor) first. DHT11 DATA to pin 2, + to 5V, - to GND.

name: Traffic light
summary: Runs red, green and yellow LEDs like a real traffic light, with an optional walk button.
where: Paste into the Arduino IDE, choose your board and port, and press Upload. Red LED on pin 12, yellow on pin 11, green on pin 10 (each with a 220 ohm resistor); optional button between pin 2 and GND.

name: Hello + input basics
summary: Your first C++ program: prints text, asks questions, and does math with your answers.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 hello-input.cpp -o hello-input and then ./hello-input.

name: Number guessing game
summary: The computer picks a number from 1 to 100 and tells you higher or lower until you guess it.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 guess-number.cpp -o guess-number and then ./guess-number.

name: Rock paper scissors
summary: Play rock paper scissors against the computer, first to 3 wins.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 rock-paper-scissors.cpp -o rock-paper-scissors and then ./rock-paper-scissors.

name: Tic-tac-toe (2 players)
summary: Two players take turns on a 3x3 board; it checks for wins and ties and keeps score.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 tic-tac-toe.cpp -o tic-tac-toe and then ./tic-tac-toe.

name: Calculator
summary: A calculator that does + - * / % and powers, with divide-by-zero checks and an ans memory.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 calculator.cpp -o calculator and then ./calculator.

name: Times table quiz
summary: Asks 10 multiplication questions, then shows your score, best streak and time.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 times-table-quiz.cpp -o times-table-quiz and then ./times-table-quiz.

name: To-do list (std::vector)
summary: A to-do list app using std::vector: add, list, finish and remove tasks.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 todo-list.cpp -o todo-list and then ./todo-list.

name: Hangman
summary: Guess the secret word letter by letter before the hangman drawing is finished.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 hangman.cpp -o hangman and then ./hangman.

name: Dice roller
summary: Rolls dice like 2d6 or 1d20 with <random>, and can show a chart of 1000 rolls.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 dice-roller.cpp -o dice-roller and then ./dice-roller.

name: Text adventure: crashed spaceship
summary: A mini choose-your-path adventure with rooms, an inventory and different endings.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 text-adventure.cpp -o text-adventure and then ./text-adventure.

name: Virtual pet (class example)
summary: Teaches classes with a Pet you feed, play with and put to sleep for 10 days.
where: Paste into an online compiler like onlinegdb.com (C++17), or on your PC run: g++ -std=c++17 pet-class.cpp -o pet-class and then ./pet-class.

name: Rotating actor (Unreal)
summary: An actor that spins every frame in Tick and can also bob up and down.
where: In Unreal Engine 5, use Tools > New C++ Class > Actor named RotatingActor, then paste the RotatingActor.h part into RotatingActor.h and the RotatingActor.cpp part into RotatingActor.cpp. Replace YOURPROJECT_API with your project name in caps + _API (for example SPACEGAME_API), compile, and drag it into your level.

name: Kill volume (Unreal)
summary: A trigger box that destroys pawns that overlap it and respawns players at the Player Start.
where: In Unreal Engine 5, use Tools > New C++ Class > Actor named KillVolume, then paste the KillVolume.h part into KillVolume.h and the KillVolume.cpp part into KillVolume.cpp. Replace YOURPROJECT_API with your project name in caps + _API (for example SPACEGAME_API), compile, and drag it into your level. Your level needs a Player Start.

name: Moving platform (Unreal)
summary: A platform that ping-pongs between its start and a draggable target point, pausing at each end.
where: In Unreal Engine 5, use Tools > New C++ Class > Actor named MovingPlatform, then paste the MovingPlatform.h part into MovingPlatform.h and the MovingPlatform.cpp part into MovingPlatform.cpp. Replace YOURPROJECT_API with your project name in caps + _API (for example SPACEGAME_API), compile, and drag it into your level. Drag the Target Offset diamond to set where it travels.
